besluite.fout: 'albei' directly follows 'gespeel en gesing', so on a first reading it can attach to the two verbs rather than to the guitar and concertina.
besluite.rede: Naming the instruments removes the stumble without adding a fact or moving the meaning.
The inversion after 'en' is correct, natural Afrikaans that carries 'Vandag' into both clauses; the proposal only reorders and loosens that link.

besluite.fout: 'is net stemme' is loose spoken phrasing for what the music consists of.
besluite.rede: 'bestaan net uit stemme' is the natural written form and says exactly the same thing.
